en.title: Split Sessions by Per-User Timeout
en.description:
Sort each user's events by time; consecutive events whose time difference does not exceed t belong to the same session, otherwise a new session starts. Find the total number of sessions across all users. Different users are never merged.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n t, followed by n lines of user ID and time. The source has no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n≤200000, 0≤time,t≤10^12; an ID is 1 to 32 ASCII letters or digits; events may be out of order or repeated.
en.explanation: The examples give 3, 1 and 2 respectively; a gap exactly equal to the timeout still stays in the same session.
hints: Sort by user and time, and count the positions where the user changes or the adjacent gap is greater than t.
